title: VISA Information
description: Archived invitation-letter instructions for the Atlanta 2014 OpenStack Summit. The application deadline and requested information are historical.
body:
United States Visa Information

Complete this Form if you require an invitation letter from OpenStack Foundation in order to secure a visa to enter the United States.

Requests for invitation letters must be received before April 28, 2014.  Contact events@openstack.org if you have any questions.

You will be asked to provide the following information in the form:

  • Given Name (first name):
  • Family Name (last name):
  • Gender:
  • Nationality:
  • Passport #:
  • Country in which you currently live (location of US Embassy meeting):
  • Date of Birth (Month / Day / Year):
  • Description of involvement with OpenStack:
  • Have you already registered for the Summit - Yes/No:
  • Travel Dates:
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
